proposedImprovements.name: Quick-Start Mode
proposedImprovements.description: ~12-item checklist skipping CANNOT_EVALUATE items (UI states, runtime evidence with no running app). For first-pass diagnostic on projects <50 files.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Documentation-only: add quick-checklist.md to diagnostic pack. No code changes.

proposedImprovements.name: Student-Project Mode
proposedImprovements.description: Adjusted floor expectations. Student projects can pass with documentation gaps but NOT with security/auth gaps.

proposedImprovements.name: Report-vs-Source Mode
proposedImprovements.description: Focused mode for projects with docx/pdf reports making implementation claims. Prioritizes C (report/source consistency) over other checks.

proposedImprovements.name: API-Client Mismatch Scanner
proposedImprovements.description: Automated hint: compare frontend api/index.js calls against backend route files. Flag discrepancies.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Documentation pattern: manual check enhanced with grep-like hints. No automation script.

proposedImprovements.name: Server-Entry Ambiguity Checker
proposedImprovements.description: Detect when project has multiple index.js/app.js/main.js entry points pointing to different implementations.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Documentation: add 'multiple entry point' to architecture review checklist.

proposedImprovements.name: JWT/Config Consistency Checker
proposedImprovements.description: Compare .env values against hardcoded secrets in middleware. Flag mismatches.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Documentation pattern: check-list item RV10 enhanced.

proposedImprovements.name: Zero-Test Detector
proposedImprovements.description: Quick scan: any test framework config? any test files? any test script in package.json? If all no → flag.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Already covered by G (test quality review). Enhance with explicit zero-test flag.

proposedImprovements.name: Dist/Build Source Boundary Checker
proposedImprovements.description: Detect dist/ or build/ directories in source tree. Flag as potential source/build confusion.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Already covered by RV20. Add explicit dist/ detection hint.

proposedImprovements.name: Stop-After-Diagnostic Rule
proposedImprovements.description: Explicit rule: after diagnostic, stop and report findings. Only proceed to repair if user explicitly requests it. Prevent diagnostic→repair drift.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Add STOP_AFTER_DIAGNOSTIC rule to BOUNDARY.md and DAILY_USE.md.

proposedImprovements.name: Evidence Object vs Main Project Distinction
proposedImprovements.description: When using diagnostic on a real project for Factory evidence: label project as EVIDENCE_OBJECT. Do not let repair become main line.
proposedImprovements.implementation: Add to when-to-use.md and RUN_METADATA template.

implementationGuidance: All improvements are DOCUMENTATION-ONLY or low-risk checklist enhancements. No code changes to diagnostic pack scripts. No new verifier logic needed. Implement in FACTORY-DIAGNOSTIC-PACK-P1 if user approves.
riskAssessment: LOW — all changes are additive documentation. No breaking changes to existing checklist or verifier.
